scripts.gen:contract:
json2ts --input contract.schema.json --output src/contract.ts --no-additionalProperties --unknownAny --bannerComment '// GENERATED from contract.schema.json, which src/contract.rs emits. Do not edit; change src/contract.rs, then run
// UPDATE_SCHEMA=1 cargo test --no-default-features --features contract-schema contract_schema_is_current && npm run gen:contract'
scripts.check:contract: npm run --silent gen:contract && git diff --exit-code -- src/contract.ts
